correctness.rationale: The identities for sigma^(m-1) letter images are established by induction and concatenation. sigma^m(x) explicitly decomposes into P and B_j complete arches, each with a unique final rare letter. This proves all-prefix U_m(N) exactly by the known greedy-arch characterization. Primitive incidence eigenvectors give frequencies for every fixed integer m >= 2. Boundary m=2, N=0 and arbitrary prefix cuts are included. The verifier corroborates finitely; the proof is symbolic.
